package.description: Local collection and reliable forwarding of log data to Seq

en-US.description: Local collection and reliable forwarding of log data to Seq
en-US.longDescription: Seq Forwarder is a client-side log collector that receives events over its local HTTP API and persists them to its own internal storage until a remote Seq server can be reached.
en-US.name: Seq Forwarder

zh-CN.description: 本地收集并可靠转发日志数据至 Seq
zh-CN.longDescription: Seq Forwarder 是一款客户端日志收集器，它通过本地 HTTP API 接收事件，并将这些事件持久化存储至自身内部存储系统中，直至能够连接远程 Seq 服务器为止。

package.longDescription: Seq Forwarder is a client-side log collector that receives events over its local HTTP API and persists them to its own internal storage until a remote Seq server can be reached.
package.name: Seq Forwarder
